mentions.name: lazyslurm
mentions.description: A terminal UI for managing SLURM jobs on HPC clusters, inspired by lazygit and lazydocker, built in Rust with ratatui.
mentions.source_excerpt: lazyslurm is a tui for managing slurm jobs on HPC clusters. It's kind of like lazygit or lazydocker. I've been chipping away at it for the last few months. Its built in rust w/ ratatui.
